profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. describes itself on its site as a cloud monitoring as a service provider, offering a way to see metrics from all of an organization's apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial. The same site material describes integrating security and observability so organizations can decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response at what the company calls agentic speed, framed as a defense against AI-powered attacks.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker DDOG, with CIK 0001561550. It is also listed under the name DATADOG INC - CLASS A.

Litigation exposure is recorded in New York, with a count of 448. No individual lawsuits are listed, and no products are tracked.
